sentence: Dadda yetteddu ad yegmer iselman yal tagara n dduṛt.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by LdjuherTaqvaylit (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: My older brother goes fishing every weekend.

usageExamples: Tom yetteddu aṭas ɣer din akken ad yurar icahen.
Tom often goes there to play chess.
